pairs.evidence: src/i18n/locales.manifest.ts:13 claims no other file enumerates locales, but two switchers keep hand-made lists and the onboarding one (src/features/onboarding/components/AppearanceStep.tsx:13) already omits bn/id/vi, so 3 of 14 shipped locales cannot be picked at onboarding

techniques.evidence: src/features/home/sub_welcome/LanguageSwitcher.tsx:16 and src/features/onboarding/components/AppearanceStep.tsx:13 declare their own language tables instead of deriving from LOCALES; per-language font config also sprawls into src/stores/i18nStore.ts:20 - the one-line-diff test fails (adding a locale touches 3+ files)

src/features/onboarding/components/AppearanceStep.tsx:13 offers 11 of 14 served locales (published bn/id/vi work unreachable from that switcher); per-key fallback itself is realized by the deep-merge loader (src/features/home/sub_releases/i18n/useReleasesTranslation.ts:7)

.claude/rules/i18n.md:164 makes medium-quality machine translation the committed bar for gap-fill; scripts/i18n/translate-merge.mjs gates only key and placeholder parity, so unreviewed subagent output lands in the reviewed catalog with no marker separating it
scripts/i18n/check-untranslated.mjs:17 per-locale "<lang>:<key>" allowlist (with *: wildcard for locale-independent classes), gated at pre-commit by lefthook.yml:85
src/i18n/pseudoLocale.ts:2 dev-only pseudo-locale synthesized from English with no engine
scripts/i18n/plan-gaps.mjs:60 attaches per-key translator notes to gap chunks; surface, glossary terms and placeholder map are still left to the subagent (per the registry's own personas application)

pairs.registryProposal: canonical-and-derived-split names this desktop app as committing catalogs because every string went through the review wave first; its gap-fill path (.claude/rules/i18n.md:164, translate-extract -> Sonnet subagent -> translate-merge) has no review wave, so the technique's cited example is only half-true. Correct the sighting, and consider whether a bundled offline app needs a sanctioned third shape: machine output committed but provenance-marked per key. Separately: home-welcome (src/features/home/sub_welcome/LanguageSwitcher.tsx) and onboarding-components (src/features/onboarding/components/AppearanceStep.tsx) hold the two shadow language lists but carry no translation-pipeline-topology pair; the matcher missed them because they use switcher/picker vocabulary, not translation/pipeline.
